title: Smokey's — house rules, guest book and communal dining

actions.title: SMOKEY'S — HOUSE RULES
pages:
SMOKEY'S — HOUSE RULES

1. Weapons stay holstered inside.
2. If you eat from COMMON, put something back when you can.
3. Tell the desk where you came from and where you're going.
4. Sick, bitten, feverish — say it before you come upstairs.
5. Don't touch another person's bag.
6. Radio stays on schedule. Batteries are not for personal sets.
7. If somebody comes looking for a name, check the book.

We don't ask what you did before.
We care what you do here.
